# Kalappura Houseboats & Tours — Complete Information

## Overview
Kalappura Houseboats & Tours is a private houseboat operator in Alleppey (Alappuzha), Kerala, India. We provide overnight houseboat stays on the Kerala backwaters with traditional kettuvallam-style boats equipped with modern amenities.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a houseboat in Alleppey cost?
Houseboat rates at Kalappura start from ₹15,000 per room per night for the Standard package. Premium costs ₹19,000 and Semi Luxury costs ₹24,000 per room per night. All prices include meals, AC, and backwater cruise. 18% GST is additional.

### What is included in a houseboat stay?
Every booking includes: overnight backwater cruise (12 PM to 9 AM), all meals (lunch, evening tea & snacks, dinner, breakfast), air-conditioned bedrooms, private bathrooms, onboard crew (captain, chef, helper), cruise through Vembanad Lake and village canals, and free parking.

### What is the best time to visit Alleppey for a houseboat?
October to February is peak season with comfortable weather (22-32°C). March to May is summer with slightly lower rates. June to September is monsoon with the best prices (up to 30% off) but occasional rain.

### How many people can stay on a houseboat?
1 Bedroom boat: up to 3 guests (ideal for couples). 2 Bedroom boat: up to 6 guests (small families). 3 Bedroom boat: up to 9 guests (groups and large families).

### Is the houseboat private or shared?
All our houseboats are completely private. You are never sharing with other groups. The entire boat is exclusively for you and your party.

### What is the check-in and check-out time?
Check-in is at 12:00 PM (noon). Check-out is at 9:00 AM the next morning. This gives you approximately 21 hours on the water.

### Is food included?
Yes, all meals are included: lunch, evening tea with snacks, dinner, and breakfast. An onboard chef prepares fresh Kerala cuisine. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options are available.

### Are houseboats air-conditioned?
Yes, all bedrooms have AC. The duration varies by package: Standard (8:30 PM–6:30 AM), Premium (5:30 PM–7:30 AM), Semi Luxury (all the time).

### Can I book for a honeymoon?
Yes. The 1 Bedroom Houseboat is ideal for couples and honeymooners. You get complete privacy with the entire boat to yourselves. Special arrangements like flower decoration and candlelight dinner can be requested during booking.

### What is the cancellation policy?
Free cancellation up to 7 days before check-in. Within 7 days: 50% charge. No-shows: full charge.

### How do I pay?
Only 20% advance is required at booking. Balance is paid at the property on check-in day. We accept credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking, and cash.

### Are children allowed?
Yes, we are family-friendly. Children under 5 stay free. Children 6-11: ₹1,000/night extra. Life jackets available for all ages.

### Are pets allowed?
No, pets are not allowed on our houseboats for safety and comfort reasons.

### Is there WiFi on the houseboat?
Yes, WiFi is available. Mobile signal works throughout most of the cruise route.

### What happens if it rains?
Houseboats are covered and weatherproof. Cruising continues in light rain. In heavy monsoon, cruising may be limited but the stay remains comfortable.

### How do I reach the houseboat?
Our dock is in Alleppey (Alappuzha), Kerala. Nearest airport: Cochin International (85 km, 2 hours). Nearest railway station: Alleppey (2.5 km). Free parking available at our dock.

## Boat Types

### 1 Bedroom Houseboat (Single Bedroom)
- Ideal for: Couples, honeymooners, solo travellers
- Capacity: Up to 3 guests
- Size: Compact boat
- Bedrooms: 1 (Double bed + futon)
- Starting price: ₹17,500/night (weekday), ₹20,000/night (weekend)
- Features: AC, private bathroom, river view, living room, kitchen, premium experience

### 2 Bedroom Houseboat (Double Twin Room)
- Ideal for: Small families, two couples, friend groups
- Capacity: Up to 6 guests
- Size: Medium boat
- Bedrooms: 2 (Double bed + futon per room)
- Starting price: ₹16,500/night (weekday), ₹18,500/night (weekend)
- Features: AC, private bathrooms, lake view, terrace, kitchen

### 3 Bedroom Houseboat (Standard Cabin)
- Ideal for: Large families, groups
- Capacity: Up to 9 guests
- Size: Large boat
- Bedrooms: 3 (Double bed + futon per room)
- Starting price: ₹17,500/night (weekday), ₹20,000/night (weekend)
- Features: AC, private bathrooms, balcony, lake & river view, kitchen, terrace, soundproof
